financial_years.quote: the impugned order in GSTIN: 33AAHFV3417D1ZI/2018-19 dated 04.09.2024 passed by the 2nd respondent

date.quote: the notice in Form GST DRC-01 was issued by the respondents on 13.02.2024

events.quote: the notice in Form GST DRC-01 was issued by the respondents on 13.02.2024
for which, the reply, along with all the relevant documents, were filed by the petitioner on 24.04.2024.
the writ petition in W.P.No.4402 of 2025 has been filed challenging the impugned assessment order dated 04.09.2024

the same was rejected vide the impugned rejection order dated 29.01.2025 on the ground that the rectification application will be considered only when there is any error apparent on the original order.

document_contents.quote: the impugned order was passed by the respondent as if no documents were furnished.

defects_argued.quote: In this case, the impugned assessment order was passed without considering the reply filed by the petitioner, which is a clear violation of principles of natural justice and hence, the said assessment order is liable to be set aside.

outcome.quote: The impugned assessment order dated 04.09.2024 and the impugned rejection order dated 29.01.2025 are hereby set aside and the matter is remanded back to the Assessing Officer for fresh consideration.
